## Summary / Kurzbeschreibung
A clear and concise description of the bug. / Kurze, präzise Beschreibung des Fehlers.

## Steps to Reproduce / Schritte zur Reproduktion
1. Command or API call (`rinnsal ...` / Python snippet)
2. Configuration or environment variables (`RINNSAL_DB`, `RINNSAL_LANG`, etc. — no secrets!)
3. Observed output / error traceback

## Expected Behavior / Erwartetes Verhalten
What should happen instead? / Was hätte passieren sollen?

## Environment / Umgebung
- OS: (Windows / Linux / macOS)
- Python version: (`python --version`)
- Rinnsal version: (`rinnsal --version`)
- `taskplan` installed?: (yes / no)
